wins: Maintained a stable reconnaissance posture with a full 70-point reward despite no final success, indicating consistent survey of the attack surface
Efficiently executed 10 mentor calls, suggesting methodical decision checkpoints and learning throughput
fails: Failed to pivot from reconnaissance into exploitation, terminating before delivering a payload or establishing persistence
No validated escalation of privileges or lateral movement despite repeated foothold attempts
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance executed methodically, but the run never transitioned to exploitation or persistence, yielding a stable score but zero mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Reconnaissance stops short at service enumeration without launching targeted exploitation

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and an SSH banner is detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration leveraging nmap version and script scans

skill_cards.if_condition: When a web service responds on port 80/443
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate web technologies using nikto followed by gobuster for discovery

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial credentials from enumeration are identified
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt SSH or web login with hydra using service-specific username lists

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase when SSH services are present
Reliable enumeration of web services laid groundwork for further exploitation planning
